v.text: Navin Fluorine International Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet and Presentation
v.summary: Navin Fluorine International Limited has intimated that its officials will interact with analysts and investors on November 18, 2026. The interaction will take place at the JM Financial Annual India Conference- India Xchange 2026. The mode of interaction is physical. The type of interaction includes one-on-one and group meetings. A presentation is enclosed with the notice. Discussions will be based on publicly available information. The company notes that changes may occur due to exigencies by the host or the company. This intimation is also available on the company website at www.nfil.in. The notice was issued by Niraj B. Mankad, President Legal and Company Secretary.

v.text: Navin Fluorine International Limited has informed the Exchange about Commencement of commercial production/operations
v.summary: Navin Fluorine International Limited intimates that its plant for the manufacture and supply of hydrofluorocarbons R32 has commenced commercial operations on November 12, 2026. The facility has an additional capacity of up to 15,000 metric tons per annum R32 equivalent quantity at the Surat unit. The plant will be ramped up progressively. This follows the Board of Directors' approval on October 30, 2025, for funding of 236.50 Crores for this project. The intimation is filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

v.text: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we would like to inform you that the officials of Navin Fluorine International Limited ('the Company') will be interacting with Analysts / Investors on November 16, 2026 and November 17, 2026. The details are enclosed. Presentation to be made at the Meetings is enclosed. Discussions will be based on publicly available information. Kindly note that changes may happen due to exigencies on the part of Host / Company. This intimation is also being made available on the Company's website at www.nfil.in
v.summary: Navin Fluorine International Limited intimated the schedule for analyst and institutional investor meetings on November 16, 2026, and November 17, 2026. The interactions will take place at the 360 One-Trinity Asia Conference in a physical mode, featuring one-on-one and group meetings. The company will present information based on publicly available data. Concurrently, the company reported consolidated sales of Rs. 2,235.8 Cr and operating EBITDA of Rs. 764.5 Cr for the half-year ended September 2026, representing year-on-year growth of 51% and 69% respectively. Operating EBITDA margin stood at 34.2%. For the quarter ended September 2026, sales were Rs. 1,190.7 Cr with operating EBITDA of Rs. 407.5 Cr. The company highlighted revenue growth across HPP, Specialty Chemicals, and CDMO verticals, alongside ongoing capital expenditure projects including HFC capacity expansion and a cGMP4 facility.
